prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1170; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented for evaluation following a side-impact motor vehicle collision that occurred at an intersection. Reported mechanism involved lateral impact to the driver's side with possible head contact against the window frame. No loss of consciousness was reported, though the patient described transient dizziness and a brief period of disorientation at the scene.

At the initial visit, the patient complained of headache rated as moderate in severity, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological examination showed intact cranial nerves, normal strength and coordination, and a mildly positive finding on balance testing. Cognitive screening revealed mild deficits in short-term recall. A diagnosis of concussion was made, and the patient was advised on cognitive and physical rest, avoidance of screen use for extended periods, and return precautions for worsening headache, vomiting, confusion, or drowsiness.

At the follow-up visit, symptoms had partially improved. Headache had decreased in frequency, though light sensitivity and fatigue persisted. Balance testing was within normal limits and cognitive screening showed improvement. A graduated return-to-activity plan was initiated, and the patient was instructed to return for reassessment if symptoms recurred or failed to resolve within the expected recovery window.
